title: षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 56 · The merit of hearing the Bharata

summary.en: Janamejaya asks to hear the full story. Vaishampayana praises the work Vyasa composed over three years as holy and complete: whatever is found here on dharma, wealth, pleasure and liberation is found elsewhere, and what is not here is nowhere.
summary.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಲು ಜನಮೇಜಯನು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವ್ಯಾಸರು ಮೂರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ ಗ್ರಂಥವನ್ನು ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನನು ಪವಿತ್ರ, ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣವೆಂದು ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಧರ್ಮ ಅರ್ಥ ಕಾಮ ಮೋಕ್ಷಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿರುವುದು ಬೇರೆಡೆ ಇದೆ, ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ್ದು ಎಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय पूरी कथा सुनना चाहते हैं। वैशम्पायन व्यास द्वारा तीन वर्षों में रचे इस ग्रन्थ की पवित्र और सम्पूर्ण कहकर स्तुति करते हैं: धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष के विषय में जो यहाँ है वह अन्यत्र है, और जो यहाँ नहीं वह कहीं नहीं।
summary.te: పూర్తి కథను వినాలని జనమేజయుడు కోరుతాడు. వ్యాసుడు మూడు సంవత్సరాలలో రచించిన గ్రంథాన్ని వైశంపాయనుడు పవిత్రమైనదిగా, పరిపూర్ణమైనదిగా కీర్తిస్తాడు: ధర్మార్థకామమోక్షాల గురించి ఇక్కడ ఉన్నది ఇతరత్ర ఉంది, ఇక్కడ లేనిది ఎక్కడా లేదు.
summary.ta: முழுக் கதையைக் கேட்க ஜனமேஜயன் விரும்புகிறான். வியாஸர் மூன்றாண்டுகளில் இயற்றிய இந்நூலை வைஶம்பாயனர் புனிதமானது, முழுமையானது என்று புகழ்கிறார்: அறம், பொருள், இன்பம், வீடு பற்றி இங்குள்ளது பிற இடங்களிலும் உண்டு, இங்கு இல்லாதது எங்கும் இல்லை.
summary.ml: മുഴുവൻ കഥയും കേൾക്കണമെന്ന് ജനമേജയൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. മൂന്നു വർഷം കൊണ്ട് വ്യാസൻ രചിച്ച കൃതിയെ വൈശമ്പായനൻ പുണ്യവും സമ്പൂർണവുമെന്ന് പ്രശംസിക്കുന്നു: ധർമ്മം, സമ്പത്ത്, സുഖം, മോക്ഷം എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ച് ഇവിടെയുള്ളത് മറ്റിടങ്ങളിലും കാണും; ഇവിടെയില്ലാത്തത് ഒരിടത്തും ഇല്ല.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.56; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथितं वै समासेन त्वया सर्वं द्विजोत्तम ।
महाभारतमाख्यानं कुरूणां चरितं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Best of brahmins, you have told me all of it briefly: the story of the Mahabharata, the great deeds of the Kurus.

verses.text:
कथां त्वनघ चित्रार्थामिमां कथयति त्वयि ।
विस्तरश्रवणे जातं कौतूहलमतीव मे ॥

meaning.en: Blameless one, as you tell this tale of wondrous meaning, a great eagerness has arisen in me to hear it at length.

verses.text:
स भवान्विस्तरेणेमां पुनराख्यातुमर्हति ।
न हि तृप्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत् ॥

meaning.en: You should therefore tell it again in full. I am not satisfied hearing the great deeds of my forebears.

verses.text:
न तत्कारणमल्पं हि धर्मज्ञा यत्र पाण्डवाः ।
अवध्यान्सर्वशो जघ्नुः प्रशस्यन्ते च मानवैः ॥

meaning.en: The reason cannot be small, if the Pandavas, who knew dharma, killed those who should not be killed and are yet praised by men.

verses.text:
किमर्थं ते नरव्याघ्राः शक्ताः सन्तो ह्यनागसः ।
प्रयुज्यमानान्संक्लेशान्क्षान्तवन्तो दुरात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Why did those tigers among men, though capable and blameless, endure the torments inflicted on them by wicked men?

verses.text:
कथं नागायुतप्राणो बाहुशाली वृकोदरः ।
परिक्लिश्यन्नपि क्रोधं धृतवान्वै द्विजोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: How, best of brahmins, did mighty-armed Vrikodara, with the strength of ten thousand elephants, hold back his anger even while suffering?

verses.text:
कथं सा द्रौपदी कृष्णा क्लिश्यमाना दुरात्मभिः ।
शक्ता सती धार्तराष्ट्रान्नादहद्घोरचक्षुषा ॥

meaning.en: How did Draupadi Krishna, though capable and chaste, when tormented by the wicked, not burn the sons of Dhritarashtra with her terrible gaze?

verses.text:
कथं व्यतिक्रमन्द्यूते पार्थौ माद्रीसुतौ तथा ।
अनुव्रजन्नरव्याघ्रं वञ्च्यमानं दुरात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: How did the two sons of Pritha and the two sons of Madri go along with it at the dice game, following the tiger among men, Yudhishthira, as he was cheated by wicked men?

verses.text:
कथं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठः सुतो धर्मस्य धर्मवित् ।
अनर्हः परमं क्लेशं सोढवान्स युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: How did Yudhishthira, the best of those who uphold dharma, son of Dharma and knower of dharma, undeserving, endure that supreme suffering?

verses.text:
कथं च बहुलाः सेनाः पाण्डवः कृष्णसारथिः ।
अस्यन्नेकोऽनयत्सर्वाः पितृलोकं धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: And how did the Pandava Arjuna, with Krishna as his charioteer, alone shooting, send those vast armies to the world of the fathers?

verses.text:
एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं यथावृत्तं तपोधन ।
यद्यच्च कृतवन्तस्ते तत्र तत्र महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Tell me all this as it happened, rich in austerity, and whatever each of those great chariot-warriors did at each point.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
महर्षेः सर्वलोकेषु पूजितस्य महात्मनः ।
प्रवक्ष्यामि मतं कृत्स्नं व्यासस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: I will tell you the whole thought of the great sage Vyasa of boundless power, honored in all the worlds.

verses.text:
इदं शतसहस्रं हि श्लोकानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
सत्यवत्यात्मजेनेह व्याख्यातममितौजसा ॥

meaning.en: This work of a hundred thousand verses of holy matter was expounded here by the son of Satyavati, of immeasurable power.

verses.text:
य इदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नरः ।
ते ब्रह्मणः स्थानमेत्य प्राप्नुयुर्देवतुल्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: The learned person who recites this, and the one who hears it, reach the abode of Brahma and attain equality with the gods.

verses.text:
इदं हि वेदैः समितं पवित्रमपि चोत्तमम् ।
श्राव्याणामुत्तमं चेदं पुराणमृषिसंस्तुतम् ॥

meaning.en: It is equal to the Vedas, holy and supreme; the best of things to be heard, an ancient work praised by sages.

verses.text:
अस्मिन्नर्थश्च धर्मश्च निखिलेनोपदिश्यते ।
इतिहासे महापुण्ये बुद्धिश्च परिनैष्ठिकी ॥

meaning.en: In this history of great merit, profit and dharma are taught completely, and so is a final, settled wisdom.

verses.text:
अक्षुद्रान्दानशीलांश्च सत्यशीलाननास्तिकान् ।
कार्ष्णं वेदमिमं विद्वाञ्श्रावयित्वार्थमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: A learned man who recites this Veda of Krishna to those who are generous, truthful, not mean and not unbelieving gains his goal.

verses.text:
भ्रूणहत्याकृतं चापि पापं जह्यादसंशयम् ।
इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा पुरुषोऽपि सुदारुणः ॥

meaning.en: Even a man of very terrible deeds, on hearing this history, would doubtless shed the sin of killing an unborn child.

verses.text:
जयो नामेतिहासोऽयं श्रोतव्यो विजिगीषुणा ।
महीं विजयते सर्वां शत्रूंश्चापि पराजयेत् ॥

meaning.en: This history is called Jaya, "Victory," and should be heard by one who wants to win; he conquers the whole earth and defeats his enemies.

verses.text:
इदं पुंसवनं श्रेष्ठमिदं स्वस्त्ययनं महत् ।
महिषीयुवराजाभ्यां श्रोतव्यं बहुशस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: It is the best rite for bringing a son, and a great blessing; a queen and a crown prince should hear it again and again.

verses.text:
अर्थशास्त्रमिदं पुण्यं धर्मशास्त्रमिदं परम् ।
मोक्षशास्त्रमिदं प्रोक्तं व्यासेनामितबुद्धिना ॥

meaning.en: It is a holy treatise on profit, a supreme treatise on dharma, and a treatise on liberation, as said by Vyasa of boundless intellect.

verses.text:
संप्रत्याचक्षते चैव आख्यास्यन्ति तथापरे ।
पुत्राः शुश्रूषवः सन्ति प्रेष्याश्च प्रियकारिणः ॥

meaning.en: Some tell it now, and others will tell it; and there are sons eager to listen and servants who please their masters.

verses.text:
शरीरेण कृतं पापं वाचा च मनसैव च ।
सर्वं तत्त्यजति क्षिप्रमिदं शृण्वन्नरः सदा ॥

meaning.en: Whatever sin is done by the body, by speech or by mind, a man who always hears this quickly sheds it all.

verses.text:
भारतानां महज्जन्म शृण्वतामनसूयताम् ।
नास्ति व्याधिभयं तेषां परलोकभयं कुतः ॥

meaning.en: For those who listen without envy to the great birth of the Bharatas, there is no fear of illness, much less fear of the next world.

verses.text:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं पुण्यं तथैव च ।
कृष्णद्वैपायनेनेदं कृतं पुण्यचिकीर्षुणा ॥

meaning.en: It brings fortune, fame, long life, heaven and merit; Krishna Dvaipayana made it wishing to do good.

verses.text:
कीर्तिं प्रथयता लोके पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च भूरिद्रविणतेजसाम् ॥

meaning.en: He made it to spread in the world the fame of the great-souled Pandavas and of other kshatriyas of great wealth and power.

verses.text:
यथा समुद्रो भगवान्यथा च हिमवान्गिरिः ।
ख्यातावुभौ रत्ननिधी तथा भारतमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: As the ocean, the divine one, and the mountain Himalaya are both famed as storehouses of jewels, so the Bharata is called.

verses.text:
य इदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्ब्राह्मणानिह पर्वसु ।
धूतपाप्मा जितस्वर्गो ब्रह्मभूयं स गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: The learned man who recites this to brahmins on the sacred days of the lunar month shakes off sin, wins heaven, and attains oneness with Brahman.

verses.text:
यश्चेदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान्पादमन्ततः ।
अक्षय्यं तस्य तच्छ्राद्धमुपतिष्ठेत्पितॄनपि ॥

meaning.en: One who recites it to brahmins at a shraddha rite, even a quarter verse at the end, makes that shraddha imperishable and it reaches the ancestors.

verses.text:
अह्ना यदेनश्चाज्ञानात्प्रकरोति नरश्चरन् ।
तन्महाभारताख्यानं श्रुत्वैव प्रविलीयते ॥

meaning.en: Whatever sin a man commits by day through ignorance as he goes about is dissolved by hearing the Mahabharata account.

verses.text:
भारतानां महज्जन्म महाभारतमुच्यते ।
निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: It is called Mahabharata, the "great birth of the Bharatas"; one who knows its derivation is freed from all sins.

verses.text:
त्रिभिर्वर्षैः सदोत्थायी कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः ।
महाभारतमाख्यानं कृतवानिदमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Over three years, the sage Krishna Dvaipayana, always rising early, composed this excellent Mahabharata story.

verses.text:
धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च भरतर्षभ ।
यदिहास्ति तदन्यत्र यन्नेहास्ति न तत्क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: About dharma, wealth, desire and liberation, bull of the Bharatas: what is here may be found elsewhere, but what is not here is nowhere.
